2.192.16
NumericIndicator.IndicatorStyle
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The NumericIndicator.IndicatorStyle element is ignored if it is present. However, its data type is
validated and this value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) or an expression that
evaluates to a String. The value of this element MUST be one of the following or an expression that
evaluates to one of the following:
Mechanical

Digital7Segment

Digital14Segment

The following is the parent element of the NumericIndicator.IndicatorStyle element.
Parent elements
NumericIndicator
The following is the XML Schema definition of the NumericIndicator.IndicatorStyle element.
 <xsd:element name="IndicatorStyle" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
